title: Keep CapCut optional for final MP4 export
description: Align the V1 final-output path so an approved final preview can produce a final MP4 and manifest without requiring an optional CapCut draft.
businessContext: The pasted VOX Simple Flow V1 contract makes CapCut draft creation optional, while the current registry, packaging verifier inputs, and orchestrator block packaging until CapCut review is approved.
acceptanceCriteria: Packaging Export is eligible after approved QA, preview, timeline, voice, subtitles, assets, and script artifacts without an approved CapCut Draft.
Final-preview approval can run packaging directly and does not invoke or require CapCut.
CapCut Draft remains available as an optional explicit Export action and still invalidates a package when an existing package depends on changed upstream output.
Existing manifest path, hash, and final MP4 validation remain enforced.
Focused domain/orchestrator/packaging checks, typecheck, and diff checks pass.
humanEscalationConditions: Making CapCut optional would weaken an accepted security or export validation invariant.
Packaging cannot validate a real preview MP4 without introducing a new media or persistence mechanism.
